papers.title: Scientific applications of quantum computing: challenges and opportunities
papers.abstract: The predictive simulation of molecules and materials has had a broad and significant impact. It nevertheless remains constrained by the cost of accurately treating electronic correlation, excited states, and complex energy landscapes. Quantum computing offers a fundamentally different computational paradigm in which quantum states are encoded and manipulated directly rather than approximated on classical hardware. Here we discuss where this approach may provide a genuine scientific advantage in chemistry, materials science, and biochemistry. Promising directions include the high-accuracy treatment of correlated active spaces, improved excited-state simulations, and accelerated exploration of combinatorial structure spaces. The central challenge is therefore not qubit scaling alone, but demonstrably chemically meaningful gains in predictive reliability. We argue that near-term value is most likely to come from disciplined workflow integration rather than wholesale replacement of classical methods. Noisy physical devices, error-mitigated utility experiments, early fault-tolerant devices, and fully fault-tolerant quantum computers offer different scientific prospects, and claims of usefulness must be tied to the specific regime being discussed. Quantum computing will become scientifically valuable when it demonstrably reduces uncertainty in computed energies, rates, spectra, or materials stability after the full costs of state preparation, measurement, error handling, and coupling to classical simulation are included.

papers.title: Effective field equations with stochastic initial conditions
papers.abstract: The evolution of quantum field expectation values from an initial non-equilibrium quantum state can be followed numerically using the Truncated Wigner technique. It can track non-perturbative quantum phenomena, such as false vacuum decay, in real time with promising results. Nevertheless, it is an approximate method subject to quantum loop corrections. The extension of Truncated Wigner into a fully fledged effective field equation approach is discussed here, including corrections from higher loops and higher momenta.

papers.title: Jump-Diffusion Stochastic Quantization for Euclidean Lattice Field Theories
papers.abstract: We construct the natural generalization of stochastic quantization (in the Markovian sense) by considering jump-diffusion processes. This class of stochastic processes exhibits non-continuous paths, so-called Lévy flights. In the presence of jumps, action landscapes with barriers can be efficiently explored, improving and even restoring ergodicity where traditional diffusion approaches become inefficient. We explore different strategies for constructing efficient jump updates, which we deploy to address the benchmark problem of topological freezing in 2d U(1) gauge theory.

papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入跳跃-扩散过程（Lévy flights）作为随机量子化的自然推广，能够高效穿越作用量势垒，改善甚至恢复传统扩散方法失效时的遍历性，从而缓解拓扑冻结问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入跳跃-扩散过程（Lévy flights）作为随机量子化的自然推广，能够高效穿越作用量势垒，改善甚至恢复传统扩散方法失效时的遍历性，从而缓解拓扑冻结问题。；创新点：首次将跳跃-扩散过程（而非连续扩散）系统性地引入随机量子化框架，并展示了其在具有势垒的作用量景观中恢复遍历性的能力，直接应用于格点场论中的拓扑冻结难题。

papers.title: Dynamical spectral functions from bitstring-sampled quantum subspaces: entanglement, not one-body magic, tracks the sampling cost
papers.abstract: Sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD) and quantum-selected configuration interaction (QSCI) are the electronic-structure methods with most hardware traction, yet their canonical target -- the ground-state energy -- is where classical methods have caught up. We move the target to dynamics and the resource question. From one bitstring-sampling primitive -- computational-basis measurements of a shallow real-time circuit, with no Hadamard or controlled unitaries -- we reconstruct, from sampled subspaces, the single-particle spectral functions $A(ω)$ and $A(k,ω)$ and the neutral-sector dynamical structure factors $S(q,ω)$ and $S^{zz}(q,ω)$, each built classically in the Lehmann representation from its own subspace. The reconstruction matches exact diagonalization on Hubbard chains and, for $A(ω)$, across nineteen molecules (FCI-verified to $<10^{-5}$ Ha), and runs on the IBM Heron processor. Second, we ask which resource controls the cost -- the determinant support $|\mathcal{S}|$ the sampler must populate. On number-conserving states the fermionic AntiFlatness collapses to one 1-RDM invariant, $\mathcal{F}_1 = 4\,\mathrm{tr}[γ(1-γ)] = 2N_u$. An orbital-rotation (Gaussian) invariant while $|\mathcal{S}|$ is basis dependent, $\mathcal{F}_1$ is provably decoupled from the cost; the cost is instead lower-bounded and tracked by the entanglement -- the minimal bond dimension $χ$ (Spearman $ρ= 0.90$). One-body magic is thus a faithful multireference diagnostic but an unreliable cost predictor; any genuine advantage lives in the non-Gaussianity of the higher-body cumulants. We prove moment exactness and a sampling bound polynomial in $|\mathcal{S}|$, independent of Hilbert-space dimension. Self-consistent configuration recovery improves the subspace under device noise, while a learned generative model does not beat that classical baseline.

papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从浅层实时量子线路的计算基测量（bitstring 采样）中，可以在 Lehmann 表示下经典重构动力学谱函数，且精度与精确对角化一致；采样成本不由单体魔法（one-body magic）决定，而是由量子纠缠（最小键维数 χ）控制（Spearman ρ=0.90）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从浅层实时量子线路的计算基测量（bitstring 采样）中，可以在 Lehmann 表示下经典重构动力学谱函数，且精度与精确对角化一致；采样成本不由单体魔法（one-body magic）决定，而是由量子纠缠（最小键维数 χ）控制（Spearman ρ=0.90）。；创新点：将 SQD/QSCI 的目标从基态能量转向动力学谱函数，并系统揭示采样成本与纠缠（而非单体魔法）的定量关联；证明 F₁ 与采样成本解耦，并给出多项式采样界。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。

papers.title: Assessing the Projector Augmented-Wave Method for Stopping Power Calculations
papers.abstract: The stopping power of charged particles is investigated using time-dependent density functional theory (TDDFT). Such simulations are made possible by recent advances in computational resources and numerical implementations of this first-principles method. In practice, DFT simulations widely employ the projector augmented-wave (PAW) method to approximate all-electron behaviour, but the implications of the PAW approximation for non-adiabatic stopping simulations remain insufficiently explored. Here, the suitability of the PAW method for stopping power simulations is evaluated. A workflow for generating and selecting PAW datasets tailored to these simulations is developed, enabling systematic optimisation of augmentation radii and projector constructions. The approach is applied to proton stopping in FCC aluminium, demonstrating how dataset design influences stopping predictions, and enabling an investigation of crystal channelling effects on charged-particle transport.

papers.title: Extracting a nitrile-centered, ether-assisted motif hierarchy for lithium-battery electrolyte design from billion-scale molecular space
papers.abstract: Designing electrolyte molecules for lithium batteries requires balancing electronic stability with appropriate Li+ solvation, yet the structural basis remains unclear across chemically diverse molecules. High-throughput screening expands the searchable space, but ranked candidates alone do not reveal recurring motifs or their applicability limits. We searched nearly one billion GDB13 structures using electronic--solvation descriptors without explicit functional-group preferences or scaffold constraints. Across descriptor weights, high-ranking populations separated into a nitrile-dominant regime and a coexistence regime containing substantial fractions of both nitrile- and ether-containing molecules. These regimes together define a nitrile-centered, ether-assisted motif hierarchy: nitrile remains favored across broad weight ranges, whereas ether becomes prominent under stronger electrostatic and polarity constraints. Encoding this hierarchy in a generative model expands the candidate space beyond GDB13 and yields high-scoring fluorinated structures without an explicit fluorination reward. Explicit-solvent molecular dynamics simulations show weak, exchangeable coordination of representative candidates without displacing ethylene carbonate from the dominant first solvation shell around Li+; effects on ion association and transport depend on molecular structure and concentration. These results establish a quantitative, interpretable and physically bounded motif hierarchy that systematizes established nitrile and ether chemistry for lithium-battery electrolyte design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要提及“high-throughput screening”“generative model”“molecular dynamics simulations”等计算与模拟方法，未涉及实验合成或表征。；研究对象：锂离子电池电解液分子。具体为从近十亿级GDB13化学空间筛选出的含腈基（nitrile）和醚基（ether）的有机小分子，以及它们与Li⁺的溶剂化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在近十亿分子空间中，基于电子-溶剂化描述符的筛选结果呈现“腈主导”与“腈/醚共存”两个区域，共同构成“腈为中心、醚为辅助”的基序层级：腈基在宽权重范围内占优，醚基在更强静电与极性约束下凸显。代表性候选分子对Li⁺呈现弱、可交换的配位，不取代碳酸乙烯酯（EC）在Li⁺第一溶剂化壳层中的主导地位。

papers.title: Controlling rotations of magnetically levitated superconductors
papers.abstract: Magnetically trapped type-I superconductors are promising candidates for precision experiments at the quantum-to-classical borderline, with applications in quantum sensing of forces and accelerations and fundamental tests of quantum physics. Here, we show how the rotational motion of micron-sized superconductors is strongly affected by (i) the diamagnetic torques due to the gradient of the trapping field and by (ii) the gyromagnetic coupling due to Einstein-de Haas and Barnett effects. We show that this allows the three-dimensional alignment of asperhical superconductors in the trap center, as required for future sensing applications and quantum experiments, and determine the resulting librational trapping frequencies. Finally, we propose an experiment to probe gyromagnetic coupling in levitated superconductors and we discuss how it can be used to control the particle rotation.

papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超导微粒的旋转运动受陷阱磁场梯度的抗磁力矩和陀磁耦合共同主导，利用这些效应可实现非球形超导体在磁阱中心的三维定向，并确定相应的天平动（librational）囚禁频率；同时提出了一种探测悬浮超导体中陀磁耦合的实验方案，并讨论了利用该耦合控制粒子旋转的途径。；创新点：首次系统展示了抗磁力矩与陀磁耦合对微米级悬浮超导体旋转运动的联合影响，并利用这些效应实现三维取向控制——这是未来量子传感和量子实验所需的关键能力；同时提出了直接探测悬浮超导体中陀磁耦合的实验方案。

papers.title: Half a qubit: an algebraic fractionalization
papers.abstract: Fractionalizing a quantum two-level system is usually associated with encodings based on pairs of Majorana fermions---an operational fractionalization. We show an alternative algebraic fractionalization by embedding Székely's classical ``half-coin'' into a non-Hermitian Krein space. The coefficients of $(q+pz)^{1/2}$ define a signed sequence and a normalized, non-Hermitian biorthogonal operator describing a biorthogonal half-qubit. We prove that two such objects fuse into an arbitrary pure qubit through the signed Vandermonde convolution that the collective $N\ge2$ vectors are null in Krein space. $L_1$ norm of the half-qubit follows in closed form, $\lVert p\rVert_1 = 2\sqrt{q}-\sqrt{q-p}$. Its $L_1$ norm increases monotonically with the bias and attains its supremum $\sqrt{2}$ precisely at the unbiased point $p=q=1/2$. Interestingly, we identify two structural results as follows. First, number parity and the $η$-metric generate a distinguished commuting $\mathbb Z_2\times\mathbb Z_2$ subgroup. Second, we find the $η$-metric obstructs any local $η$-self-adjoint partner of the parity, so a half-qubit carries a $\mathbb{Z}_2$ observable but no local $SU(2)$. The full Pauli algebra emerges only upon fusion. We then show that the construction survives truncation of the Fock basis: the fused qubit is exact at every cutoff, and the Vandermonde cancellation is visible in sign-weighted photon-number statistics, and can be tested using existing cavity and trapped-ion state-synthesis methods. Finally, we generalize this algebraic fractionalization to a $1/n$-qubit, which can be achieved by replacing the square root with an $n$th root.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：algebraic fractionalization、non-Hermitian Krein space、biorthogonal operator、证明（prove）、结构结果（structural results）。；研究对象：量子二能级系统（qubit）的分数化（fractionalization）现象，具体为将经典“半硬币”（half-coin）嵌入非厄米Krein空间所构造的“半量子比特”（half-qubit）及其融合性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将Székely的经典“半硬币”嵌入非厄米Krein空间，实现了量子二能级系统的代数分数化，构造出双正交半量子比特；两个这样的对象通过带符号Vandermonde卷积融合为一个任意纯量子比特，且该构造在Fock基截断下保持精确。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将Székely的经典“半硬币”嵌入非厄米Krein空间，实现了量子二能级系统的代数分数化，构造出双正交半量子比特；两个这样的对象通过带符号Vandermonde卷积融合为一个任意纯量子比特，且该构造在Fock基截断下保持精确。；创新点：提出了一种不同于基于Majorana费米子对编码的“操作性分数化”的替代方案——代数分数化；发现半量子比特携带$\mathbb Z_2$可观测量但无局域$SU(2)$，完整的Pauli代数仅在融合后出现；并证明该构造在Fock基截断下保持精确，可通过现有腔和离子阱态合成方法进行实验检验。

papers.title: In-situ adjoint protocols for nonlinear PT-symmetric self-optimizing machines
papers.abstract: Adjoint methods provide a powerful route for gradient-based optimization, but their physical implementation is obstructed in generic nonlinear systems because the adjoint dynamics requires backward-time evolution, Jacobian transposition, and terminal-value constraints. Here we show that nonlinear parity-time ($\mathcal{PT}$)-symmetric systems overcome this obstruction. Using a class of nonlinear non-Hermitian resonator networks, we establish symmetry relations that map the formal adjoint dynamics onto experimentally accessible forward-time evolutions supplemented by controlled injections. This construction enables exact in-situ evaluation of adjoint gradients without requiring explicit backward propagation or matrix transposition. We demonstrate the approach in nonlinear $\mathcal{PT}$-symmetric resonator chains, where the resulting optimization protocol autonomously discovers parameter configurations that realize prescribed spatio-temporal functionalities, including uniform energy redistribution and targeted wave transport at predefined time windows. Our results identify $\mathcal{PT}$ symmetry as a resource for implementing computational sensitivities within physical systems and establish a route toward self-optimizing nonlinear machines.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：symmetry relations、formal adjoint dynamics、demonstrate the approach in nonlinear chains（含数值演示）。；研究对象：非线性非厄米谐振子网络，具体为非线性PT（宇称-时间）对称谐振子链，以及其中基于梯度优化的自优化物理机器。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非线性PT对称系统能够克服伴随法（adjoint method）在物理实现中的障碍，通过对称关系将形式伴随动力学映射为可实验实现的、带受控注入的前向时间演化，从而在无需反向传播或矩阵转置的情况下，原位精确计算伴随梯度，实现自优化非线性机器。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非线性PT对称系统能够克服伴随法（adjoint method）在物理实现中的障碍，通过对称关系将形式伴随动力学映射为可实验实现的、带受控注入的前向时间演化，从而在无需反向传播或矩阵转置的情况下，原位精确计算伴随梯度，实现自优化非线性机器。；创新点：首次将PT对称性作为计算灵敏度的物理资源，提出并验证了在非线性物理系统中原位实现伴随梯度计算的具体方案，开辟了无需反向传播的自优化非线性机器实现路径。

papers.title: Deep-learning classification of physically admissible nuclear-matter equations of state
papers.abstract: Thermodynamic stability and causality impose fundamental constraints on the equation of state (EoS) of nuclear matter. Verifying these constraints conventionally requires calculating quantities such as the specific heat, baryon-number susceptibility, and speed of sound, which can become computationally expensive when many candidate EoSs must be examined. We investigate whether the normalized pressure surface, $Q(T,μ_B)=P(T,μ_B)/T^4$, alone contains sufficient information to determine the physical admissibility of an EoS. We develop a supervised convolutional neural network (CNN) that uses only this pressure representation to classify EoSs as physically admissible or inadmissible. The network is provided with training labels obtained from direct thermodynmaic stability and causality check and its does not get any information about the parameters of the underlying EoS framework. For EoSs generated within an Ising-mapping framework, the model achieves $97.65%$ accuracy on unseen test data. Applied independently to EoSs from a distinct holographic framework, it achieves perfect classification of the test set. These results show that pressure surfaces contain geometric signatures of thermodynamic stability and causality violations that can be learned directly by a CNN. Because the classifier relies only on the pressure surface, it avoids evaluating higher-order thermodynamic observables during inference and is largely independent of the EoS-generation framework. When the pressure surface is supplied as a two-dimensional array, the machine-learning validation is approximately 20 times faster than direct validation. Our results establish a fast, framework-independent approach for identifying physically admissible EoSs directly from their pressure surfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：supervised convolutional neural network、classification、machine-learning validation。；研究对象：核物质状态方程（EoS）的物理可容许性判定，具体研究压力曲面 $Q(T,\mu_B)=P(T,\mu_B)/T^4$ 是否足以判断热力学稳定性与因果性约束。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 仅利用归一化压力曲面作为输入，卷积神经网络即可高精度区分物理可容许与不可容许的核物质状态方程，在Ising映射框架生成的数据上测试准确率达97.65%，在独立的全息框架数据上实现完全正确分类，且验证速度比直接热力学检验快约20倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：仅利用归一化压力曲面作为输入，卷积神经网络即可高精度区分物理可容许与不可容许的核物质状态方程，在Ising映射框架生成的数据上测试准确率达97.65%，在独立的全息框架数据上实现完全正确分类，且验证速度比直接热力学检验快约20倍。；创新点：首次证明压力曲面本身包含热力学稳定性和因果性违反的几何特征，可由CNN直接学习；分类器在推理阶段无需计算高阶热力学观测量，且对EoS生成框架具有框架无关性，显著加速了候选EoS的筛选过程。
papers.method_zh: 监督式卷积神经网络（CNN），输入为二维压力曲面 $Q(T,\mu_B)$ 数组；训练标签由直接热力学稳定性与因果性检查（计算比热、重子数磁化率、声速等）生成；网络不接收EoS生成框架的任何参数信息。测试数据分别来自Ising映射框架和全息框架。

papers.title: Transport-defined photodetection through electrically selectable nonequilibrium carrier transport
papers.abstract: Broadband optical fields can change in both intensity and spectral distribution, but a fixed-response detector maps this evolving information onto a single electrical signal. Here we demonstrate transport-defined photodetection, in which electrical bias selects how photoexcited carriers are redistributed, escape and are collected, creating complementary response functions within one shared active region. In a GaAs/AlGaAs semiconductor ratchet, light-driven ratchet transport defines the response at 0 V, whereas the spectral evolution at -2 V is consistent with field-assisted hot-carrier transport. The overlapping states span a measured spectral range of 0.4-94.5 μm at 5 K, provide state-dependent calculated detection floors and support joint infrared operation at 30 K. Direct optical beat notes at 7.432 GHz in the mid-infrared and 17.103 GHz in the terahertz demonstrate optical-to-electrical conversion. Their common-path outputs recover an imposed spatial temperature gradient and the transient field-of-view-integrated effective radiation temperature of laser-excited graphite. These results establish post-photoexcitation transport as a function-defining design variable for semiconductor photodetectors, complementing structure-defined, field-tuned and optically encoded approaches to reconfigurable photodetection.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了对GaAs/AlGaAs半导体棘轮器件的实际测量，包括光谱响应范围、光拍频信号、温度梯度恢复等实验观测。；研究对象：GaAs/AlGaAs半导体棘轮（ratchet）结构中的非平衡载流子输运现象，以及基于此实现的可重构光电探测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过施加不同偏压，可以在同一有源区内选择不同的光生载流子输运机制（光驱动棘轮输运 vs. 场辅助热载流子输运），从而获得互补的光电响应函数，实现“输运定义”的光电探测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过施加不同偏压，可以在同一有源区内选择不同的光生载流子输运机制（光驱动棘轮输运 vs. 场辅助热载流子输运），从而获得互补的光电响应函数，实现“输运定义”的光电探测。；创新点：将光激发后的载流子输运过程本身作为半导体光电探测器的功能定义设计变量，与已有的结构定义、场调谐和光学编码等可重构探测方案形成互补。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。

papers.title: Topologically Protected Learning from Exceptional Point Braiding: Toward Braid Programming
papers.abstract: We present a framework for topological learning based on exceptional point (EP) braiding in a non-Hermitian Bogoliubov-de Gennes Hamiltonian. A closed algebraic equation for the EP super-surface is derived; through momentum quantisation in finite systems, it predicts the exact number and parameter positions of all EPs in real space, irrespective of system size. The EP topology is characterised by two quantised invariants the state-swap fidelity and the normalised Berry phase which cannot both be zero for a topological EP. A complete topological map shows that all EPs lie within a specefic region. Adiabatic encirclements confirm robust state swapping and yield a universal set of braid gates, including Pauli-X, Pauli-Y, Pauli-Z, a Hadamard-like gate, the T-gate, and a SWAP operation, with the special case where a is 0, providing additional phase gates. Building on these generators, we reformulate learning as braid programming a discrete search over the braid group that replaces gradient descent on continuous weights with combinatorial optimisation. A proof-of-concept genetic search successfully discovers short braid words that reproduce the standard Hadamard gate and the H.Z gate with perfect fidelity. This paradigm offers inherent noise immunity, catastrophic-forgetting prevention through compositional concatenation, and guaranteed generalisation by mathematical construction, establishing EP braiding as a promising substrate for robust, interpretable, and topologically protected neuromorphic computation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“非厄米Bogoliubov-de Gennes哈密顿量”“推导出闭合代数方程”“拓扑不变量”“绝热环绕”等理论推导与概念，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：非厄米Bogoliubov-de Gennes哈密顿量中的奇异点（Exceptional Point, EP）辫群（braiding）拓扑结构，以及基于该拓扑结构实现的类神经形态计算（neuromorphic computation）框架。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作建立了EP辫群拓扑与通用量子门（Pauli-X/Y/Z、Hadamard类门、T门、SWAP等）之间的对应关系，并提出将机器学习中的梯度下降替换为辫群上的组合优化（即“辫子编程”），通过遗传搜索可高保真复现标准Hadamard门和H·Z门，从而实现具有天然噪声免疫、抗灾难性遗忘和可保证泛化能力的拓扑保护计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作建立了EP辫群拓扑与通用量子门（Pauli-X/Y/Z、Hadamard类门、T门、SWAP等）之间的对应关系，并提出将机器学习中的梯度下降替换为辫群上的组合优化（即“辫子编程”），通过遗传搜索可高保真复现标准Hadamard门和H·Z门，从而实现具有天然噪声免疫、抗灾难性遗忘和可保证泛化能力的拓扑保护计算。；创新点：首次将EP辫群拓扑直接映射为通用计算门集合，并据此提出“辫子编程”（braid programming）范式，以组合优化替代连续权重梯度下降，从数学构造上保证泛化能力与噪声免疫。摘要未突出说明与已有非厄米拓扑计算工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：推导EP超曲面的闭合代数方程，利用有限系统中的动量量子化预测EP数目与参数位置；拓扑表征：定义态交换保真度（state-swap fidelity）和归一化Berry相位两个量子化不变量；数值模拟：绝热环绕模拟验证态交换鲁棒性；算法实现：将学习问题重构为辫群上的离散搜索，采用遗传算法（genetic search）作为组合优化工具进行概念验证。

papers.title: Longitudinal-Field-Driven Transition in a non-integrable Non-Hermitian Transverse-Field Ising Chain via RBMs
papers.abstract: We investigate the ground-state properties and quantum critical behavior of a non-Hermitian transverse-field Ising chain subjected to longitudinal and complex transverse magnetic fields. To address this interacting many-body problem, we employ real-valued neural quantum states based on Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBMs), optimized using Variational Monte Carlo (VMC) sampling. Spectral analysis of finite chains reveals exceptional points associated with spontaneous parity-time (PT) symmetry breaking. A real-valued RBM framework is developed to reconstruct the ground-state eigenstates of the non-Hermitian Hamiltonian. Benchmark comparisons with exact diagonalization demonstrate that the RBM approach accurately reproduces the ground-state energy, magnetization, and spin-spin correlations. Extending the analysis to larger system sizes, we identify a non-Hermitian quantum phase transition characterized by PT-symmetry breaking and the emergence of magnetic order. Our results establish real-valued neural quantum states as an efficient and scalable framework for investigating critical phenomena in interacting non-Hermitian quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“employ real-valued neural quantum states based on Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBMs), optimized using Variational Monte Carlo (VMC) sampling”，以及“Benchmark comparisons with exact diagonalization”，属于数值计算方法研究。；研究对象：非厄米横场伊辛链，同时施加纵向场和复数横场，研究其基态性质与量子临界行为，特别是PT对称性破缺驱动的非厄米量子相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非厄米横场伊辛链中，通过RBM神经量子态方法识别出由PT对称性自发破缺和磁有序涌现所表征的非厄米量子相变；有限尺寸谱分析揭示了与自发PT对称性破缺相关的例外点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非厄米横场伊辛链中，通过RBM神经量子态方法识别出由PT对称性自发破缺和磁有序涌现所表征的非厄米量子相变；有限尺寸谱分析揭示了与自发PT对称性破缺相关的例外点。；创新点：将实值RBM神经量子态框架推广到非厄米、不可积（non-integrable）多体系统，证明其能高效且可扩展地重构非厄米哈密顿量的基态本征态，并用于研究非厄米临界现象。摘要未突出说明与已有非厄米数值方法（如精确对角化或张量网络）相比的具体优势细节。

papers.title: Gas-generating reactive flows in bicontinuous catalyst support structures
papers.abstract: A major challenge in the field of heterogeneous catalysis is selecting an optimal catalyst support structure. Commercially available structures can be easily manufactured at scale, but their stochastic nature makes their chemical and transport properties suboptimal. This is particularly relevant for gas-generation reactions, where non-uniformity of a porous structure leads to bubble trapping. Such trapping impedes the flow of reactants to catalyst sites, leading to conversion inefficiencies. Previous experimental work demonstrated that spinodally-derived architectures, in particular bicontinuous interfacially jammed emulsion gels (bijels), can alleviate these issues and deliver superior performance. However, to the best of our knowledge, numerical studies to optimize the operating conditions for such a morphology have not been performed yet. In this work, we aim to close this gap using color-gradient lattice Boltzmann simulations of reactive flows with a novel central moments collision operator. We develop an analytical model to predict catalyst performance based on our simulation data. Our findings show that this type of morphology can achieve very high conversion efficiencies. Moreover, we demonstrate that its catalyst performance can be optimized using superhydrophilic surface coatings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“numerical studies”“color-gradient lattice Boltzmann simulations”“analytical model”。；研究对象：双连续催化剂载体结构（bicontinuous catalyst support structures），具体为旋节线分解衍生的双连续界面堵塞乳液凝胶（bijels）中的气体生成反应流动，涉及多孔结构内的气泡捕集与反应物输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该双连续形态可实现非常高的转化效率，且催化剂性能可通过超亲水表面涂层进一步优化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该双连续形态可实现非常高的转化效率，且催化剂性能可通过超亲水表面涂层进一步优化。；创新点：首次对双连续（bijel）形态的催化剂载体进行数值优化研究，填补了此前仅有实验工作而无数值模拟的空白；同时引入超亲水表面涂层作为性能优化手段。
papers.method_zh: 采用带有中心矩碰撞算子的颜色梯度格子玻尔兹曼方法（color-gradient lattice Boltzmann simulations with a central moments collision operator）对反应流动进行数值模拟，并基于模拟数据建立解析模型以预测催化剂性能。

papers.title: Renormalization Group Analysis of Pairing Instabilities in Nuclear Fermi Liquids
papers.abstract: A nuclear Fermi liquid exhibits competing pairing instabilities in different spin, isospin, and orbital channels. In a Fermi-surface renormalization group (RG) treatment, the channel that develops a pole first is determined not only by its tree-level attraction but also by its one-loop RG coefficient. We illustrate this mechanism in a minimal $S/P$-wave model. A spherical Fermi surface establishes the reference competition between the lowest even- and odd-parity interactions. Axial deformation changes the relevant Fermi-surface integrals and lifts the degeneracy between longitudinal and transverse $P$-wave components. In isospin-asymmetric matter, neutron--proton Fermi-momentum splitting restricts the simultaneous low-energy contribution of the two species and can terminate the $np$ running at finite threshold scales. Our calculations are intended as controlled one-loop RG illustrations rather than as quantitative nuclear-matter calculations. We show how the Fermi-surface geometry and composition can change the ordering of competing pairing instabilities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“Fermi-surface renormalization group (RG) treatment”“one-loop RG coefficient”“calculations”等理论计算关键词。；研究对象：核费米液体（nuclear Fermi liquid）中的配对不稳定性，具体涉及不同自旋、同位旋和轨道通道（S/P波）的竞争，以及费米面几何（轴向形变）和同位旋不对称性（中子-质子费米动量劈裂）对配对通道选择的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在费米面重整化群处理中，哪个配对通道先出现极点（即先失稳）不仅取决于树级吸引强度，还取决于单圈RG系数；费米面几何（轴向形变）和组分（同位旋不对称）可以改变竞争配对不稳定性的排序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在费米面重整化群处理中，哪个配对通道先出现极点（即先失稳）不仅取决于树级吸引强度，还取决于单圈RG系数；费米面几何（轴向形变）和组分（同位旋不对称）可以改变竞争配对不稳定性的排序。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但明确指出其计算是“受控的单圈RG示例”而非定量核物质计算，重点在于展示费米面几何与组分如何改变配对不稳定性排序这一机制性理解。

papers.title: Tunable Statistics-Induced Caging in the Anyon-Hubbard Model
papers.abstract: We study the quantum dynamics of two interacting anyons in the Anyon-Hubbard model on a four-site plaquette, a system that is exactly mappable to a Bose-Hubbard model. We reveal that static Aharonov-Bohm (AB) caging, induced by only specific statistical phases, emerges in the strongly interacting limit but breaks down under weak interparticle interactions. To address this, we demonstrate that statistical-factor-induced AB caging can be dynamically restored via Floquet engineering. This dynamical mechanism, governed by the synthetic Floquet flux and the anyonic statistical phase, extends the caging effect into the weakly interacting regime across the full spectrum of statistical phases. Furthermore, we show that the external drive enables the selective caging of anyons, providing an efficient approach for manipulating anyons and identifying statistical phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“exactly mappable”“Floquet engineering”“dynamical mechanism”等理论分析与动力学机制研究，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：Anyon-Hubbard模型中的两个相互作用任意子，具体为四格点plaquette上的量子动力学系统，该体系可精确映射为Bose-Hubbard模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强相互作用极限下，仅特定统计相位可诱导静态Aharonov-Bohm（AB）笼禁效应，但该效应在弱相互作用下失效；通过Floquet工程可动态恢复统计因子诱导的AB笼禁，并将其扩展到弱相互作用区及全统计相位谱，同时实现任意子的选择性笼禁。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强相互作用极限下，仅特定统计相位可诱导静态Aharonov-Bohm（AB）笼禁效应，但该效应在弱相互作用下失效；通过Floquet工程可动态恢复统计因子诱导的AB笼禁，并将其扩展到弱相互作用区及全统计相位谱，同时实现任意子的选择性笼禁。；创新点：首次提出并证明可通过Floquet驱动在弱相互作用区动态恢复统计相位诱导的AB笼禁，且该机制适用于全部统计相位谱；进一步展示了外部驱动可实现任意子的选择性笼禁，为操控任意子及识别统计相位提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与解析映射：利用任意子-玻色子精确映射将Anyon-Hubbard模型转化为Bose-Hubbard模型；采用Floquet工程（周期驱动）引入合成规范场，通过调节合成Floquet磁通与任意子统计相位来操控笼禁效应。

papers.title: Renormalization-group locking of finite anisotropic propagation cones in Yukawa networks
papers.abstract: Different field species can begin with finite anisotropic propagation geometries whose principal axes need not coincide. We ask whether local Yukawa interactions on a finite graph can nevertheless generate one common infrared spatial cone, even when the interactions that drive the locking become marginally irrelevant. Retaining the full finite mismatch between positive-definite spatial kinetic matrices, we derive the one-loop nonlinear matrix flow and show that its Thompson diameter is globally nonexpansive. On a connected graph, persistent normalized edge activity upgrades this to a uniform finite-window contraction, so all interacting sectors asymptotically share one relative propagation geometry. An explicit two-channel Pauli-Dirac Yukawa-quartic completion realizes the persistence conditions on an open weak-coupling set of finite-mismatch initial data. In four dimensions the Yukawa couplings vanish in the infrared, yet their accumulated interaction time diverges, leaving a Gaussian endpoint with a common spatial cone. For a controlled two-plateau extremal class, graph distance also fixes the first nonzero short-time order of the diameter decrease. Thus a common cone can be collectively selected by renormalization-group dynamics rather than imposed as a microscopic common structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“one-loop nonlinear matrix flow”“renormalization-group dynamics”等理论推导关键词，属于解析理论工作。；研究对象：Yukawa网络上不同场物种之间的各向异性传播几何（propagation cones）在红外极限下的重整化群锁定行为。具体体系为有限图上的多通道Yukawa相互作用模型（含Pauli-Dirac Yukawa-quartic完成）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使驱动锁定的Yukawa耦合在红外变得边缘无关（marginally irrelevant），有限失配的各向异性传播锥仍可通过重整化群动力学被统一为一个共同的红外空间锥；在四维情形下，Yukawa耦合虽趋于零，但累积相互作用时间发散，最终得到具有共同空间锥的高斯不动点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使驱动锁定的Yukawa耦合在红外变得边缘无关（marginally irrelevant），有限失配的各向异性传播锥仍可通过重整化群动力学被统一为一个共同的红外空间锥；在四维情形下，Yukawa耦合虽趋于零，但累积相互作用时间发散，最终得到具有共同空间锥的高斯不动点。；创新点：首次证明即使相互作用在红外变得边缘无关，有限失配的各向异性传播几何仍能被重整化群动力学“锁定”为共同锥，且该共同结构是集体动力学选择的结果而非微观预设。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 解析重整化群方法：推导一阶（one-loop）非线性矩阵流方程，利用Thompson直径的全局非扩张性证明收缩性质，并结合连通图上的持久归一化边活性（persistent normalized edge activity）建立有限窗口收缩。对四维情形分析Yukawa耦合的消失行为与累积相互作用时间。

papers.title: Sparse Prototype Code Underlies Classification and Prediction Across Modalities
papers.abstract: Neural representations have become a central tool for studying the internal mechanisms of modern AI models, yet their complex high-dimensional structure makes them difficult to interpret. We show that classification tasks give rise to a universal representational geometry, shared across state-of-the-art models in vision, audio, and language processing. The key structure is that within-class variability is not random in representation space. Instead, its classifier-relevant component has strong and structured correlations with the class's own centroid and with the centroids of its competing classes. Building on this observation, we derive an analytical mean-field theory governed mainly by the variability along true-class and rival-class centroid coordinates, together with a global renormalization of the class radius that compensates for the non-Gaussian statistics of real representations. The theory accurately predicts classification accuracy across architectures and modalities. The relevant geometric quantities improve systematically with model scale, mirroring the observed gains in accuracy. A striking feature of the theory is its sparsity: accurate prediction requires only a small set of centroid coordinates associated with the true class and its strongest rivals - connecting our framework to sparse-feature extraction approaches such as sparse autoencoders. Together, these results provide a parsimonious predictive theory of neural representations and suggest that classification in deep networks is governed by a sparse, centroid-aligned structure embedded within the full high-dimensional representation space.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“derive an analytical mean-field theory”（推导解析平均场理论），并使用“predicts classification accuracy across architectures and modalities”（预测跨架构和模态的分类准确率），属于理论建模与数据分析结合的研究。；研究对象：论文研究的对象是**现代人工智能模型（深度神经网络）中的神经表征（neural representations）**，具体涵盖视觉、音频和语言处理领域的先进模型。这是一个关于机器学习模型内部机制的理论物理研究，而非传统凝聚态物理中的具体材料或量子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 分类任务在深度网络表征空间中产生一种**普适的几何结构**：类内变异中与分类器相关的成分与类自身质心及竞争类质心存在强且结构化的关联。基于此，作者建立了一个**稀疏的质心对齐理论**，仅需真实类及其最强竞争类的少数质心坐标即可准确预测分类准确率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：分类任务在深度网络表征空间中产生一种**普适的几何结构**：类内变异中与分类器相关的成分与类自身质心及竞争类质心存在强且结构化的关联。基于此，作者建立了一个**稀疏的质心对齐理论**，仅需真实类及其最强竞争类的少数质心坐标即可准确预测分类准确率。；创新点：该工作的核心新意在于揭示了**跨模态、跨架构的普适表征几何**，并提出了一个**极其稀疏（sparse）的预测理论**——即准确预测分类性能仅需少量质心坐标，而非全部高维表征信息。这一发现将表征几何与稀疏特征提取方法联系起来，为深度网络的可解释性提供了简洁的物理框架。
papers.method_zh: 论文采用**解析平均场理论（analytical mean-field theory）**，该理论主要考虑沿真实类和竞争类质心坐标的变异，并引入一个全局的类半径重整化以补偿真实表征的非高斯统计特性。此外，论文还结合了**稀疏特征提取方法（如稀疏自编码器，sparse autoencoders）** 的视角来连接其理论框架。

papers.title: Local observable errors from truncating interaction tails in gapped quantum lattice systems
papers.abstract: We bound the error in ground-state expectations of local observables caused by truncating the spatial tails of a gapped quantum lattice Hamiltonian. We show that the error is controlled by the interaction strength discarded near each site, rather than by the extensive norm of the omitted Hamiltonian. If the gap remains open along a path that removes the interaction tail, the resulting bounds are uniform in system size and extend, under suitable assumptions, to thermodynamic-limit ground states. The convergence rate reflects the decay of the interaction tail: it is algebraic for power-law interactions, superpolynomial for superpolynomial interactions, and exponential at any strictly smaller rate for exponentially decaying interactions. For superpolynomial interactions, we also derive a direct infinite-volume estimate using automorphic equivalence. The results extend to isolated low-energy sectors and parity-even fermionic systems. For two-body interactions decaying as $r^{-p}$ in $d$ dimensions, we prove an error bound $O(R^{-(p-d)})$ for $p>2d$, where $R$ is the truncation range. We construct a gapped non-translation-invariant example that saturates this scaling, showing that the bound is optimal for the general class considered. Our results quantify when finite-range truncations faithfully reproduce the local physics of gapped long-range systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及数学证明（“We bound the error…”）、严格不等式推导（“We prove an error bound…”）以及构造性例子（“We construct a gapped non-translation-invariant example…”），属于解析理论工作。；研究对象：有能隙的量子晶格系统（gapped quantum lattice systems），特别是具有长程相互作用（power-law、superpolynomial、exponential decay）的哈密顿量在截断空间尾部后的基态局域观测量误差。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 截断有能隙晶格哈密顿量的相互作用尾部时，局域观测量的基态期望值误差由每个位点附近被丢弃的相互作用强度控制，而非被省略哈密顿量的整体范数。对于d维空间中按r^{-p}衰减的两体相互作用，当p>2d时，误差界为O(R^{-(p-d)})，且该标度被构造的例子证明是最优的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：截断有能隙晶格哈密顿量的相互作用尾部时，局域观测量的基态期望值误差由每个位点附近被丢弃的相互作用强度控制，而非被省略哈密顿量的整体范数。对于d维空间中按r^{-p}衰减的两体相互作用，当p>2d时，误差界为O(R^{-(p-d)})，且该标度被构造的例子证明是最优的。；创新点：首次严格证明了截断误差由局域相互作用强度而非哈密顿量整体范数控制，并给出了与相互作用衰减速率匹配的最优误差标度（幂律、超多项式、指数衰减分别对应代数、超多项式、指数收敛率）。摘要未突出说明与已有具体工作的对比，但“最优性证明”和“扩展到低能扇区及宇称偶费米子系统”是明确的新贡献。
papers.method_zh: 采用解析证明方法：利用谱间隙条件与局域扰动理论（quasi-adiabatic continuation / automorphic equivalence），沿去除相互作用尾部的路径保持能隙开放，从而获得系统尺寸均匀的误差界；对超多项式相互作用还使用了自同构等价性（automorphic equivalence）直接推导无限体积估计。通过构造非平移不变的有能隙例子来证明误差界的饱和性。

papers.title: Postselection-Free Reconstruction of Monitored SPT Flux-Charge Responses
papers.abstract: A class of monitored topological invariants compares ordinary and symmetry-twisted quantum trajectories with identical stochastic records, so direct estimation requires exponentially costly matched-record postselection. We replace the twisted quantum experiment by uniformly randomized symmetry eigenstates with known charges, ordinary-boundary monitoring, and an offline twist decoder. Their correlation yields an exact finite-time response identity and removes this experimental sampling bottleneck. When the ordinary charge sharpens and the ordinary-to-flux deformation has trivial net readout-character flow, the response converges to the projective commutator of the symmetry-protected-topological phase; generator-pair responses then determine its finite-Abelian cohomology class. Spectator-sector crossings may close the global Lyapunov gap without changing this character-valued response. In monitored cluster circuits, the decoder is exact and polynomial in the Gaussian limit, while Gaussian-drop reconstruction treats interacting records; independent joint-sector spectroscopy and effect-state diagnostics validate the topological deformation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：monitored topological invariants、finite-time response identity、projective commutator、Gaussian limit。；研究对象：受监测量子线路（monitored cluster circuits）中对称性保护拓扑（SPT）相的磁通-电荷响应，特别是无需后选择（postselection-free）的拓扑不变量重构方案。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将扭曲量子实验替换为均匀随机化对称本征态与离线扭曲解码器，可精确获得有限时间响应恒等式，从而消除指数代价的匹配记录后选择瓶颈；该响应在特定条件下收敛到SPT相的射影对易子，并确定其有限阿贝尔上同调类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将扭曲量子实验替换为均匀随机化对称本征态与离线扭曲解码器，可精确获得有限时间响应恒等式，从而消除指数代价的匹配记录后选择瓶颈；该响应在特定条件下收敛到SPT相的射影对易子，并确定其有限阿贝尔上同调类。；创新点：首次提出无需后选择的SPT磁通-电荷响应重构方案，将指数成本的匹配记录后选择替换为多项式成本的离线解码，并建立了响应与射影对易子及有限阿贝尔上同调类的严格对应关系。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：随机量子轨迹与对称性扭曲（symmetry-twisted）比较；引入离线扭曲解码器（offline twist decoder）与均匀随机化对称本征态；在Gaussian极限下给出精确多项式解码器，并用Gaussian-drop重构处理相互作用记录；辅以独立联合扇区谱与效应态诊断验证拓扑形变。

papers.title: Universal Frame Potential Hierarchy in Critical Projected Ensembles
papers.abstract: Local measurements transform a many body wavefunction into a statistical ensemble of conditional quantum states. In chaotic systems, the higher moments of such ensembles diagnose the emergence of quantum state randomness, but their structure at equilibrium quantum criticality is largely unknown. Here we show that the projected ensemble of a Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid exhibits a universal nonlinear hierarchy of state overlap moments. Remarkably, the leading scaling exponents are independent of the continuously varying Luttinger parameter. Replica boundary conformal field theory reveals a geometric origin: outcome locking combines the active replica swaps into a single collective rotated sector, while intersecting compact replica branes eliminate the leading interaction dependent zero mode contribution. Matrix product state calculations across the interacting XXZ critical phase and direct free fermion calculations independently confirm the interaction independence and nonlinear hierarchy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“Replica boundary conformal field theory”（复制边界共形场论）、“Matrix product state calculations”（矩阵乘积态计算）、“free fermion calculations”（自由费米子计算），均为理论推导与数值计算方法，无实验手段描述。；研究对象：Tomonaga-Luttinger液体（一维相互作用量子液体）的投影系综（projected ensemble），具体关注其在量子临界（平衡临界性）条件下的高阶矩行为，以及相互作用XXZ临界相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Tomonaga-Luttinger液体的投影系综展现出普适的非线性态重叠矩层级结构，其主导标度指数与连续变化的Luttinger参数无关，即具有相互作用无关的普适性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Tomonaga-Luttinger液体的投影系综展现出普适的非线性态重叠矩层级结构，其主导标度指数与连续变化的Luttinger参数无关，即具有相互作用无关的普适性。；创新点：首次揭示平衡量子临界体系中投影系综高阶矩的普适非线性层级结构，并证明其标度指数不依赖Luttinger参数（即相互作用强度），突破了以往认为临界性质会随连续参数变化的预期。摘要未突出说明与具体实验的关联。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：复制边界共形场论（replica boundary CFT），用于揭示几何起源（outcome locking与复制膜相交机制）；数值方法：矩阵乘积态（MPS）计算（覆盖相互作用XXZ临界相）；解析方法：直接自由费米子计算（用于独立验证）。

papers.title: Scalable dynamical inference of phase-field fracture from sparse and partial measurements
papers.abstract: Evolving crack fields in structural health monitoring and fracture assessment must often be inferred from sparse mechanical measurements rather than dense full-field observations. We develop CNN2D--ConvGRU, a convolutional-recurrent framework for measurement-conditioned reconstruction of time-dependent phase-field brittle fracture. At each load step, the model maps a fixed-length history of phase and displacement fields and sparse current-step displacement measurements to the current full-field state. New measurements are assimilated during sequential deployment, making the framework a state-inference surrogate rather than an autonomous time integrator. It reproduces crack paths, damage evolution, and bulk displacement response, with the largest errors near propagating crack tips and steep displacement gradients and some drift at late stages. Without retraining, weights learned on a $256 \times 256$ raster are evaluated on a $512 \times 512$ raster of the same physical domain and finite-element discretization using a proportionally refined measurement grid. This empirical raster-and-sensing transfer preserves the principal damage topology and global damage evolution, although fine-scale displacement errors increase near crack tips. Comparisons with alternative spatial and temporal architectures show that CNN2D--ConvGRU offers a favorable balance between reconstruction accuracy and computational cost. Relative to repeated finite-element solutions, sequential reconstruction achieves mean speedups of $175\times$ on CPU and $253\times$ on GPU. These results demonstrate efficient full-field fracture-state reconstruction from sparse observations while retaining the spatial structure and history dependence of phase-field fracture.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法类文章。判断依据：开发了CNN2D–ConvGRU卷积-循环神经网络框架，属于计算模拟与机器学习方法研究。；研究对象：相场脆性断裂的时空演化场，具体为裂纹路径、损伤演化及体位移响应，涉及结构健康监测中的稀疏力学测量反演问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CNN2D–ConvGRU框架能够从稀疏且局部的位移测量中高效重建全场的相场断裂演化，在裂纹尖端附近误差最大，且无需重新训练即可实现从256×256到512×512网格的迁移，重建速度较有限元求解平均加速175倍（CPU）和253倍（GPU）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CNN2D–ConvGRU框架能够从稀疏且局部的位移测量中高效重建全场的相场断裂演化，在裂纹尖端附近误差最大，且无需重新训练即可实现从256×256到512×512网格的迁移，重建速度较有限元求解平均加速175倍（CPU）和253倍（GPU）。；创新点：将测量数据同化嵌入循环神经网络框架，使其作为状态推断代理而非自主时间积分器，实现稀疏测量条件下的全场断裂状态实时重建；同时展示了无需重新训练即可在更细栅格上迁移的“栅格-传感”经验性泛化能力。
papers.method_zh: 卷积-循环混合神经网络（CNN2D–ConvGRU），以固定长度的相场和位移场历史及当前步稀疏位移测量为输入，逐载荷步输出当前全场状态；采用256×256栅格训练，并在512×512栅格上测试迁移能力；与替代空间和时间架构进行对比，并评估CPU/GPU加速比。

papers.title: Proposal of a consistent value for the mean excitation energy of liquid water using advanced modeling, detailed simulations and precission proton Bragg curves
papers.abstract: Protontherapy precision depends on accurately knowing the stopping power of liquid water, as it is the most abundant component of soft body tissues. Difficulties when working with volatile liquids have led to a long-standing debate regarding the values of the stopping power and the mean excitation energy $I$ of liquid water. The equivalence between the stopping power of liquid water and amorphous ice per unit mass density across all clinically relevant proton energies opens the possibility to obtain a reliable estimation of the $I$-value of liquid water. In this work, we employ two complementary theoretical methodologies to assess the proton stopping power of water. The MELF-GOS (Mermin Energy Loss Function - Generalized Oscillator Strengths) approach, based on the perturbative dielectric formalism, serves as an accurate reference for sufficiently high energies, while the novel non-perturbative TDDFT-Penn (time-dependent density functional theory - Penn) method ensures accuracy for energies even below the stopping maximum. These stopping-power values were incorporated into the simulation code SEICS (Simulation of Energetic Ions and Clusters through Solids) to evaluate proton Bragg curves from $1$ to $230$ MeV. Comparisons with available precise depth-dose measurements provide critical insights that help establish the consistent value $I = 79.4$ eV for liquid water, providing robust physical grounds for improving range prediction for treatment planning.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与模拟结合实验对比的混合类型。判断依据：使用了理论建模（MELF-GOS、TDDFT-Penn）、模拟代码（SEICS），并与精确的质子布拉格曲线实验测量进行对比。；研究对象：液态水的平均激发能（I值）及其质子阻止本领，具体涉及液态水与非晶冰在单位质量密度下阻止本领的等价性，以及质子布拉格曲线（1–230 MeV）。

papers.title: Transitions to super-radiance in ensembles of incoherently pumped emitters
papers.abstract: Super-radiance is a striking phenomenon resulting from the collective interaction of emitters with light, and it is fundamentally related to the appearance of long-range correlations between the dipole moments of the emitters. As such, it represents a distinct phase of dissipative many-body systems compared to the case of independent emitters, similarly to how ferromagnetism stands out in magnetic materials in contrast to paramagnetism. In this work we address the conditions under which the transition to super-radiance can occur in ensembles of emitters subject to dephasing and individual decay -- a situation which is particularly relevant to the case of emitters in the solid state. The simplifying assumption of an ensemble of permutationally invariant emitters allows for the efficient solution of both the dissipative dynamics after a pulsed excitation, as well as of the steady state under incoherent pumping. This exact solution allows us to benchmark a truncated cumulant expansion approach, which can give predictions for arbitrarily big system sizes. We show that super-radiance is fundamentally robust to sizable dephasing and non-radiative decay rates, both under a pulsed excitation, as well as under continuous pumping. This robustness is the result of the collective acceleration effect of super-radiant emission with respect to the individual coupling to a local environment. We establish the universal critical scaling laws at the transition between normal radiance and super-radiance; and we show that, in the super-radiant phase, significant finite-size crossovers can be observed before reaching the asymptotic scaling regime. Our results pave the way for future experiments to provide a quantitative characterization of the scaling properties of super-radiance, seen as a distinct non-equilibrium many-body phase in ensembles of incoherently pumped emitters.

papers.title: Driven Time Crystal in Low-Symmetry ENZ Conductors
papers.abstract: In recent years, epsilon-near-zero (ENZ) materials have attracted a great deal of attention in nonlinear optics, as they combine field enhancement with strong, ultrafast nonlinearities. In particular, transparent conducting oxides, such as ITO, have emerged as a promising class of materials and have been extensively exploited to achieve temporal optical responses varying on the femtosecond scale using an optical pump. Most of the solutions discussed so far in the literature rely on effective $χ^{(3)}$ modulations, wherein the dominant material response is controlled by the envelope of the optical pump. Here, it is shown that low-symmetry conductors can provide an interesting alternative to transparent conducting oxides and a more natural implementation of time-crystalline behavior in optical systems with optical-cycle modulation. I demonstrate that ENZ confinement, combined with the strong anomalous-velocity nonlinearity of low-symmetry conductors, enables a subwavelength nanoparticle to develop a time-crystalline response under optical pumping. For sufficiently strong pumping, this response can overcome dissipative losses and lead to parametric amplification. Furthermore, the pump can strongly tailor the scattering and extinction of a weak probe and, in extreme cases, render the extinction negative. In this regime, the driven nanoparticle effectively amplifies the probe beam.

papers.title: Equivalence of quantum resources under ergodic dynamics
papers.abstract: Quantum resource theories characterize distinct forms of nonclassicality in many-body quantum states, raising the question of whether these resources evolve independently under generic ergodic dynamics. Considering diagnostics quadratic in the state, we show that the dynamics of different resource measures become mutually interdependent and are governed by a few common degrees of freedom. For Haar-random circuits, the purity together with a single resource witness suffices to reconstruct the remaining resource measures, as we demonstrate for coherence, various asymmetries, and number entropies. The same relations hold, to a good approximation, under chaotic Floquet and continuous-time Hamiltonian dynamics, establishing that this dynamical resource equivalence extends beyond random circuits. We further derive an exact coherence--imaginarity relation, remarkably accurate also beyond Haar-random circuits. Our results reveal an emergent simplification of many-body dynamics, in which sufficiently strong scrambling reduces seemingly distinct quantum resources to a few common dynamical degrees of freedom.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quantum resource theories、Haar-random circuits、Floquet dynamics、Hamiltonian dynamics、derive。；研究对象：多体量子态中的量子资源（如相干性、不对称性、粒子数熵等）在遍历动力学（ergodic dynamics）下的演化行为，不针对特定材料，而是通用量子多体系统。

papers.title: Separation of Flexible Enantiomers Using Shear Flow
papers.abstract: Mechanical separation of enantiomers is an attractive alternative to synthetic methods for producing enantiopure samples. Shear flow that produces solution vorticity has been shown to be a viable means for separating chiral objects on the micro- to nano-scale due to the tensorial nature of the interactions between chiral objects and the surrounding fluid. A recently-developed theory of molecular pitch characterizes these interactions using the resistance tensor and predicts the shear-induced separation of drug-like molecules from their optimized molecular geometries. We present a molecular dynamics study on the effects of incorporating molecular flexibility into the molecular pitch framework. We also evaluate the potential for enantiomeric separation of two drug molecules: bicalutamide (Casodex) and montelukast sodium (Singulair). Simulations reveal the emergence of flexibility-induced pitch distributions that result from conformational changes occurring in a realistic solvent environment. However, these distributions are weakly influenced by the solvent identity and the shearing process, producing mean scalar pitch values that are close to those from optimized gas phase structures. Despite the opposing effect of translational diffusion at the molecular scale, racemic mixtures of flexible enantiomers show linear rates of separation at the 10 ns timescale, and we predict that cm-scale separation can be achieved within hours. Additionally, we provide estimates for parameters of a Taylor-Couette device for generating laminar shear flow, as well as considerations for future experiments.

papers.title: Unraveling the Size Determination Mechanism of Nanocrystal Synthesis via Interpretable Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Deep learning models of nanocrystal synthesis enable the prediction of size and shape by encoding precursors and reaction conditions. However, their black-box nature hinders gaining deep insights into the underlying synthetic mechanisms. Here, we develop the Nanocrystal Equation Learner (NanoEQL), a fully white-box neural network to unravel the size determination mechanisms of nanocrystal synthesis. Building on the EQL architecture, eight operators are introduced to replace standard activation functions to fit the mathematical equations in nanocrystal synthesis. Among these operators, three smoothed operators address the gradient explosion of singular operators at zero. To evaluate the weights of different precursors, we develop a temperature-gated attention pooling strategy that encodes concentration-driven and reactivity-driven chemical synthesis mechanisms into the temperature gate. The NanoEQL model illustrates that the final nanocrystal size can be described by a linear equation composed of three scalars representing nanocrystallization capability (-Zp), growth capability (Zrea), and external input potential (-Zops). These interpretable scalars not only advance the rational design of nanocrystal synthesis but also establish a generalizable paradigm for deciphering chemical reaction mechanisms through white-box machine learning.

papers.title: BDIP-Net: Dual-Interaction Graph Learning for Property Prediction of Bilayer Materials
papers.abstract: Stacked bilayer materials exhibit rich stacking-dependent properties driven by the interplay between strong intra-layer bonding and weak inter-layer van der Waals interactions. The computational discovery of such materials is challenging because accurate structure generation typically relies on expensive DFT-based optimization, while existing machine-learning models often fail to explicitly distinguish different interaction types during property prediction. To address these challenges, we propose a machine-learning framework for efficient construction and property prediction of stacked bilayer materials. The framework employs a MatterSim-D3-based structural optimization workflow to generate DFT-quality bilayer structures from monolayer building blocks and stacking configurations at substantially reduced computational cost. For property prediction, we introduce BDIP-Net (Bilayer Dual-Interaction Potential Network), a graph neural network that explicitly models intra-layer and inter-layer interactions through interaction-specific potential representations and adaptive message fusion. We evaluate the proposed framework on BiDB, HetDB, and SAMBA, encompassing homobilayers, heterobilayers, and twisted bilayer systems. Results show that the MatterSim-D3-based workflow closely reproduces DFT-PBE-D3 optimized structures, while BDIP-Net consistently outperforms existing graph neural network and potential-based approaches for bilayer property prediction.

papers.title: A formal framework for higher-order spin models via hypergraphs, polymatroids, and the Tutte polynomial
papers.abstract: We develop a rigorous mathematical framework for statistical mechanics models on hypergraphs, and give conditions for lifting the classical connection between Potts model partition functions and the Tutte polynomial from graphs to hypergraphs. We define hypergraphical models and their associated partition functions, and extend these to special classes of models induced by families of interaction functions. For boolean interaction families, whose interaction functions map to $\{0,1\}$, we show that the partition function is determined by a combinatorial rank function, and we establish sufficient conditions for a hypergraph deletion-contraction recurrence and for when the rank function defines a polymatroid. We illustrate the theory by applying it to three hypergraph interaction families: Parity Ising, Delta Potts, and And Ising. The induced hypergraphical models are not isomorphic to each other, but the first two reduce to the same graphical Ising models. We identify three polymatroids naturally associated with hypergraphs for these models: respectively, the binary matroid of the incidence matrix over $\mathbb{F}_2$, the hypergraphical polymatroid, and the boolean polymatroid. For graphs, the first two reduce to the classical graphical matroid, and their partition functions recover the multivariate Tutte polynomial. The Tutte polynomial thus admits at least two distinct generalizations for hypergraphs, both satisfying a deletion-contraction recurrence: the Tutte polynomial of the binary matroid of the hypergraph incidence matrix, and a multivariate version of the Poincaré polynomial of the hypergraphical polymatroid. The partition functions of And Ising models are likewise multivariate versions of the Poincaré polynomial, here of the boolean polymatroid. These examples illustrate the much greater range of hypergraphical models and underscore the need for the unifying theory.

papers.title: The Boltzmann structure of sampling: Intrinsic $p$-value and its emergent closed-form expression
papers.abstract: We consider observables $X$ whose realizations in a sampled dataset are restricted, for example by measurement resolution, to a finite set of distinguishable categories within their possibly infinite theoretical domain. Given the probabilities of observable categories, we study the coarse-grained probability mass of families of possible datasets generated through a forward sampling process. The combinatorial construction induces an intrinsically discrete $p$-value defined directly from the sampling process rather than through additional probabilistic structure on observables. Specifying the sample means of $d+k$ arbitrary functions $g_α(X)$ defines a linear family of datasets whose probability mass is obtained as a weighted sum over integer lattice points contained within the associated polyhedron. To overcome the intractable large-$N$ combinatorics, we derive via saddle-point techniques a density approximating these probability masses in the continuum limit of forward sampling within the multinomial universality class. As a demonstration, we consider conditional sampling, where $d$ structural means are fixed while $k$ means vary over admissible datasets. The information geometry emerging from the saddle-point density, together with the spherical symmetry arising at large $N$ from the intrinsic $p$-value construction, enables efficient computation of the $p$-value in the Laplace approximation via the $χ^2_k$ distribution. The resulting statistic is given by the semi-analytic expression $2N$ times the Kullback-Leibler divergence between the information projections associated with the corresponding structural and observed linear families. These projections can be computed efficiently via standard numerical routines converging for sufficiently well-behaved sample means.

papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未完整给出最终结论，但表明该工作利用太赫兹发射光谱研究了飞秒光激发下Co/Ru异质结构中的超快轨道输运，并关注逆轨道霍尔效应在其中的作用。具体物理结论摘要未明确说明。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其新意在于将太赫兹发射光谱技术从自旋输运研究拓展到轨道输运研究，并针对Co/Ru体系探索逆轨道霍尔效应的超快动力学特征。具体创新点摘要未明确说明。

papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“demonstrate”（论证/展示）这一理论推导常用词，且核心概念“sliding ferroelectricity”（滑动铁电性）和“altermagnets”（交错磁体）均为理论预言并需第一性原理验证的物性，摘要未提及任何实验测量手段。；研究对象：具有滑动铁电性的双层交错磁体（bilayer altermagnets with sliding ferroelectricity）体系。具体物理现象为“滑动多铁性”（sliding multiferroicity），即层间滑动同时产生铁电极化和磁序（交错磁自旋劈裂）的耦合效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作证明，双层交错磁体中的滑动铁电性可以产生一种独特的滑动多铁性，从而实现自旋劈裂的非易失性电学调控（nonvolatile electrical control of spin splitting）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作证明，双层交错磁体中的滑动铁电性可以产生一种独特的滑动多铁性，从而实现自旋劈裂的非易失性电学调控（nonvolatile electrical control of spin splitting）。；创新点：首次将滑动铁电性与交错磁体（altermagnet）相结合，提出了一种全新的“滑动多铁性”机制，使得通过电场（而非电流或磁场）非易失地控制自旋劈裂成为可能。**（摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的对比）**
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体计算方法。但根据领域惯例，此类滑动铁电与磁耦合研究通常采用基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的第一性原理计算，可能包含自旋轨道耦合（SOC）效应。**（摘要未明确说明具体技术细节）**

papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CrI₃的晶格热导率表现出强烈的维度依赖性，并且弱磁有序对其声子热输运有显著影响。摘要未明确说明具体数值或趋势方向（如热导率随维度降低是升高还是降低），但明确指出这两个因素（维度、磁序）是关键调控变量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其新意在于同时考虑了维度效应与弱磁有序对CrI₃热输运的耦合影响，为理解磁性材料中声子输运的争议提供了新的计算证据。

papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“拓扑分类取决于哈密顿量的离散对称性”，并涉及“Floquet光子波导阵列”的对称性来源分析，属于理论框架构建与对称性论证，而非直接的实验测量。；研究对象：Floquet光子波导阵列中的对称性保护拓扑态。具体物理现象为：在周期性驱动（Floquet）的光子波导阵列中，如何通过结构设计实现Altland-Zirnbauer（AZ）分类中的手征、粒子-空穴及时间反演（光子学中对应z-反演）等抽象对称性，从而调控拓扑性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未完整给出最终结论，但核心思路已明确：波导阵列的结构特性（而非材料本征性质）可以“工程化”地实现AZ对称性，从而人为设计对称性保护的拓扑态。具体物理结果（如拓扑边界态的存在条件或相图）摘要未明确说明。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未完整给出最终结论，但核心思路已明确：波导阵列的结构特性（而非材料本征性质）可以“工程化”地实现AZ对称性，从而人为设计对称性保护的拓扑态。具体物理结果（如拓扑边界态的存在条件或相图）摘要未明确说明。；创新点：将AZ对称性分类从静态系统推广到Floquet光子波导阵列，并指出这些抽象对称性可由波导的**结构属性**（而非材料电子性质）直接产生，为“按需工程化”拓扑光子态提供了设计原则。摘要未突出说明与具体实验方案的结合细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论对称性分析。具体框架为Altland-Zirnbauer（AZ）十重分类方案，结合Floquet周期驱动理论，分析波导阵列结构对称性与哈密顿量离散对称性之间的对应关系。摘要未提及具体数值计算方法（如紧束缚模型、有限元模拟等）。

papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要使用“We show that”（理论推导或数值证明）以及“hybridization”（能带杂化）等理论物理术语，未提及实验样品制备或测量手段。；研究对象：波导（waveguides）中的光学自旋-轨道耦合效应，具体为**光学 Rashba 和 Zeeman 自旋织构**。体系涉及**单斜变形（monoclinic deformation）**导致的对称性破缺，以及**横电-横磁（TE-TM）模式杂化**。这是光子学中模拟电子自旋物理的平台。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有单斜对称性破缺的波导中，通过 TE-TM 模式杂化可以实现**光学 Rashba 和 Zeeman 两类自旋织构**，即光子模式的有效磁场和自旋动量锁定关系可被几何变形调控。摘要未明确说明具体数值或临界条件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有单斜对称性破缺的波导中，通过 TE-TM 模式杂化可以实现**光学 Rashba 和 Zeeman 两类自旋织构**，即光子模式的有效磁场和自旋动量锁定关系可被几何变形调控。摘要未明确说明具体数值或临界条件。；创新点：将凝聚态中经典的 **Rashba 和 Zeeman 自旋织构**概念映射到**光子波导系统**，并利用**单斜变形**这一具体几何手段实现 TE-TM 杂化调控。摘要未突出说明与以往光学自旋轨道耦合研究（如微腔激子极化激元）的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与解析/数值求解。具体框架为**波导光学模式耦合理论**，涉及 TE-TM 模式间的有效哈密顿量构建，并引入单斜变形作为对称性破缺项。摘要未明确说明是否使用特定数值软件（如 COMSOL、FDTD）或纯解析方法。

papers.title: Landau levels and magneto-optics in ${30}^{∘}$ quasiperiodic twisted bilayer graphene
papers.abstract: Author(s): Masaru Hitomi, Takuto Kawakami, and Mikito Koshino Here, the authors show how magnetic fields expose the hidden quasiband structure of 30° twisted bilayer graphene, a quasicrystal with 12-fold rotational symmetry but no translational symmetry. Their Landau-level theory reveals quantized orbits of quasiband pockets, unusual spectral patterns, and magneto-optical selection rules enforced by quasicrystalline symmetry, providing a route to quantum magneto-optics in broader quasiperiodic van der Waals materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“Landau-level theory”（朗道能级理论）、“reveals quantized orbits”（揭示量子化轨道）等理论推导与计算特征。；研究对象：30°扭转双层石墨烯（30° twisted bilayer graphene），一种具有12重旋转对称性但无平移对称性的准周期范德华材料，以及其在磁场下的朗道能级和磁光性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁场能够揭示30°扭转双层石墨烯中隐藏的准能带结构；朗道能级理论展示了准能带口袋的量子化轨道、异常的光谱图案，以及由准晶对称性强制的磁光选择定则。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁场能够揭示30°扭转双层石墨烯中隐藏的准能带结构；朗道能级理论展示了准能带口袋的量子化轨道、异常的光谱图案，以及由准晶对称性强制的磁光选择定则。；创新点：首次将朗道能级与磁光选择定则推广到30°扭转双层石墨烯这一准周期体系，证明准晶对称性可强制产生独特的磁光规则，为更广泛的准周期范德华材料中的量子磁光效应提供了理论路径。摘要未突出说明与具体实验的对比。
papers.method_zh: 朗道能级理论（Landau-level theory），结合准周期体系的能带与磁光响应计算。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如紧束缚模型或第一性原理），但属于基于对称性分析的理论框架。

papers.abstract: We investigate the ground-state properties of spinless fermions on a two-leg ladder by allowing the nearest-neighbor hopping dimerization in one leg and uniform hopping in the other. In the noninteracting limit, we find that at half filling, the system exhibits robust topological behavior if the int…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“We investigate the ground-state properties”（研究基态性质）以及“In the noninteracting limit”（在无相互作用极限下），属于典型的凝聚态理论模型研究，未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：本文研究的体系是一维两腿费米子梯子模型（two-leg fermionic ladder），具体为无自旋（spinless）费米子。该模型的特点是其中一条腿具有最近邻跳跃的二聚化（dimerization），另一条腿则为均匀跳跃。物理现象关注的是该体系在基态下的拓扑性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无相互作用极限下，当体系处于半填充（half filling）时，尽管只有一条腿具有二聚化跳跃，整个梯子系统仍表现出鲁棒的拓扑行为（robust topological behavior）。这表明耦合（两条腿之间的耦合）可以诱导出涌现的拓扑性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无相互作用极限下，当体系处于半填充（half filling）时，尽管只有一条腿具有二聚化跳跃，整个梯子系统仍表现出鲁棒的拓扑行为（robust topological behavior）。这表明耦合（两条腿之间的耦合）可以诱导出涌现的拓扑性质。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但从内容推断，其新意可能在于揭示了在非均匀二聚化（仅一条腿）的梯子体系中，腿间耦合可以诱导出整体拓扑相，而非依赖传统的每条腿独立具有拓扑结构。具体创新点需结合正文确认，摘要未明确说明。
papers.method_zh: 摘要中未明确提及具体的数值方法（如DMRG、精确对角化等）或理论框架（如拓扑不变量计算、纠缠谱分析等）。仅从摘要可判断为基于模型哈密顿量的解析或数值求解，具体手段摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: Multichannel Dyson equation for double ionization spectroscopies
papers.abstract: The method relies on the multichannel Dyson equation, which couples multiple Green’s functions through a multichannel self-energy. Importantly, approximations to the self-energy can be made static while still reproducing satellite features.

papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过多通道Dyson方程，可以在自能近似保持静态（static）的情况下，仍然正确再现卫星峰（satellite features）结构，从而避免了传统动态自能计算的复杂性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过多通道Dyson方程，可以在自能近似保持静态（static）的情况下，仍然正确再现卫星峰（satellite features）结构，从而避免了传统动态自能计算的复杂性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其创新在于证明了静态自能近似在多通道框架下仍能捕获卫星峰，突破了以往认为卫星峰必须依赖动态自能的认知。
papers.method_zh: 多通道Dyson方程框架，引入多通道自能（multichannel self-energy）来耦合多个格林函数；对自能采用静态近似。

papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该变形在圆柱几何上诱导了一个离开拓扑有序相的相变。通过将体态的全局 1-形式对称性（1-form symmetries）分解为不同的边界算符，作者证明了该相变伴随着（摘要被截断，但根据上下文推断为“对称性破缺”或“边界对称性的改变”）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可看出其新意在于：通过圆柱几何将体态对称性投影到边界，从而建立体态相变与边界对称性破缺之间的直接联系，这为理解拓扑相变提供了边界视角的诊断工具。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于 Kitaev 环面码的量子格点模型，采用圆柱几何（cylinder）进行边界分析。具体方法涉及对全局 1-形式对称性在边界上的分解与算符构造，利用对称性分析来表征相变。
